card.name: Inside numbers before dose units
card.fires_on: The space or digit inside a number right before a unit such as mg, mL, mCi or Units, mostly in dose amounts and ranges. It also fires in other numeric counts.

modes.label: Space before a dose amount
modes.description: The blank space just after a word like 'to' or 'equivalent to' and before a number with mg.

modes.label: Digit inside a dose figure
modes.description: A digit or comma within a number that is followed by mg, mL, mCi or Units.

modes.label: Digit in a general count
modes.description: A digit or comma inside a large count in non-drug web text.

card.writes: It seems to push toward round or tidy number tokens such as ten or fifty, and away from other continuations.
card.plain: It lights up while a dose or count number is still being written, just before its unit.
